Shoot a fire arrow into a bomb barrel to make it explode. Tossing a burning weapon at one works too.|Tips and Tricks|BotW}}{{Cite|Bomb Barrel|Game Screen|TotK}} also known as {{Term/Store|Bomb Stack|Bomb Stacks|NL|plural}},{{Exp Game|NL}}{{Cite|Bomb Stack|Monita|NL}} are recurring [[Object]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. Bomb Barrels go unnamed in {{TWW}}, {{TP}}, {{PH}}, {{ST}}, and {{LCT}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{TWW|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= TWW |type= Objects |category= Objects in The Wind Waker |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Where it can be found * Whether it can be interacted with and if it is important to the story or a Quest }} Bomb Barrels appear floating on the [[Great Sea]] near the [[Forsaken Fortress]] in {{TWW}}. Similar to [[Bomb]]s, though functionally similar in purpose to a maritime mine, Bomb Barrels surface then flash red with increasing rapidness as its fuse burns out, giving an indication as to when the Bomb Barrel is about to explode. If in close proximity of a Bomb Barrel when it detonates, Link will be thrown off his boat. In {{TWWHD}}, he is simply damaged instead. Direct collision with a Bomb Barrel will also cause it to explode. ==={{TP|-}}=== Bomb Barrels appear in an outside room of the [[Goron Mines]] in {{TP}}. In this room, several [[Bulblin]] archers will shoot at [[Link]] with fire-tipped [[Arrow]]s, which may detonate the Bomb Barrels scattered across the rooms. Bomb Barrels also appear in the [[Hidden Village]], which Link can use to shoot down the Bulblins around the Village. ==={{PH|-}}=== Bomb Barrels appear as obstacles in the [[World of the Ocean King]] in {{PH}}. They can be detonated from a distance using the Cannon. ==={{ST|-}}=== Bomb Barrels can be found inside a cave during the [[Three Trials]] in the [[Sand Realm]] in {{ST}}. They must be use in order to damage the [[Rocktite]]. Exploding a Bomb Barrel with the Cannon while the Rocktite is nearby forces its eye open, leaving it vulnerable to direct attacks. ==={{BotW|-}}=== Bomb Barrels appear predominately around enemy encampments in {{BotW}}. If a Bomb Barrel comes into contact with an open flame, it will detonate. Alternatively, sufficient concussive damage to a Bomb Barrel will cause it to break and explode. Link can use the [[Stasis]] [[Rune]] in conjunction with a [[Weapon]] on a Bomb Barrel to cause it to explode wherever it lands.{{Cite|Stasis
Freezing a Bomb Barrel using Stasis and then attacking it will cause it to fly off and explode at its point of impact.|Tips and Tricks|BotW}} Anything flammable within the blast radius of a Bomb Barrel will catch fire when one explodes. It is possible to detonate nearby Bomb Barrels with the blast from another Bomb Barrel, causing a chain of explosions. Despite this, explosions from Bomb Barrels cannot detonate [[Remote Bomb]] [[Rune]]s. Bomb Barrels also appear in [[Kah Okeo Shrine]], where they can be seen affixed to [[Balloon]]s. While attached to Balloons, Bomb Barrels can be directed with a [[Korok Leaf]]. If Link attempts to pick up a Bomb Barrel that is attached to Balloons, the ropes connecting them will sever. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Object |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} Bomb Barrels are highly volatile [[Object]]s that can be found throughout enemy encampments. If they come into contact with [[Fire]] or are struck with a strong blunt force, they will explode, catching everything in their vicinity on fire. Bomb Barrels can be [[Fuse]]d onto [[Shield]]s to create a Shield that will explode outward when hit. The force of this explosion will not damage [[Link]], though it may set the Shield on fire. ==Other Appearances== ==={{LCT|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Bomb Barrels appear in certain stages in {{LCT}}, such as in the Hidden Village Bulblin shootout in [[Link's Crossbow Training#Stage 5|Stage 5]]. These Bomb Barrels can be used to Link's advantage, as detonating them will defeat any nearby Bulblin. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{NL|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Descriptions NL}} Bomb Stacks appear in various Stages in {{NL}}'s {{BQ}}. They can be detonated with a strike from an [[Arrow]]. When detonated, Bomb Stacks damage anything in their blast radius. Bomb Stacks also appear as a [[Prize]] in the {{NL|-}} Plaza. When interacted with, they explode before being replaced. The explosions from the Prize do not cause any damage. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Bomb Barrels are interactable hazards that can be detonated by various means, usually attacks from either Warriors or monsters, damaging anything and anyone caught in its blast. When Bomb Barrels in the stage are detonated, any monster caught in the blast with a possible Weak-Point Gauge will have it exposed. Unlike {{BotW}}, they can be blown up with the [[Remote Bomb]] [[Rune|Sheikah Rune]] via the [[Sheikah Slate]]. During the [[Divine Beast]] combat segments, Bomb Barrels are the weapon of choice for [[Moblin]]s. Bomb Barrels are also integrated into [[Impa]]'s [[Special Attack]]. If she has either none or two Signs absorbed, Impa uses just one that has been marked with a Sign, absorbing it upon the conclusion of the detonation. If she has three active Signs, she will use a whole stack of Bomb Barrels, costing her her entire Sign stock, though she gains a Sign from the conclusion of the detonation. In the {{PotA}} Downloadable Content pack, [[Black Moblin]]s and [[Silver Moblin]]s carry them on containers and throw them at enemies that get too close or from a distance. Unlike the Bomb Barrels in {{BotW|-}} and any point in the game, they are not damaged by their own Barrels, save for exploiting a Weak-Point Gauge involving the Remote Bomb Sheikah Rune. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:BotW E3 2016 Bomb Barrel.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}A Bomb Barrel from the E3 2016 {{BotW|-}} booth File:TotK Bomb Barrel Model 2.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}A Bomb Barrel in a Shrine of Light ==See Also== {{See Also| * Barrel * Powder Keg * Time Bomb }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Explosives, Fuse-Compatible Objects |objects= TWW, TWWHD, TP, TPHD, PH, ST, BotW, TotK, LCT, NL, AoC }}
